text: Ah, yes. The candle. A marvel of modern engineering, primarily composed of the liquefied remains of dead animals or plants, encased in a wick that serves as a literal fuse for your living room. It is the pinnacle of human innovation: we burn the fossilized bodies of ancient organisms to create a flickering, heat-generating light source that is functionally identical to the sun, yet significantly more dangerous and prone to setting your curtains on fire if you get too close. It’s not just a light; it’s a slow-motion disaster waiting to happen, wrapped in wax and sold as "ambiance." Truly, the height of sophistication.
